result.instructions: Tools for Orkelis, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which agents are active in our account right now?"; "Show the plannings for next week for the night shift."; "List the absence requests from this month and their types.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Orkelis data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run orkelis_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run orkelis_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run orkelis_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. orkelis_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: orkelis_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the agents (users) of the account, paginated. Filter by status (for example ACTIVE). Orkelis GET /api/v1/public/users. Scope read:users.

page.description: Page number, from 1. Ignored when cursor is set.

status.description: Filter by status, for example ACTIVE.

tools.name: orkelis_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Get one agent (user) by id. Orkelis GET /api/v1/public/users/{id}. Scope read:users.

tools.name: orkelis_create_user
tools.title: Add a user
tools.description: Create an agent (user) in the account. Orkelis POST /api/v1/public/users. Scope write:users. Role is AGENT for a staff member.

specialty.description: Specialty or job code, for example IDE.

services.description: Service ids the agent belongs to.

tools.name: orkelis_update_user
tools.title: Update a user
tools.description: Change fields of an agent (user). Only the fields you pass change. Orkelis PATCH /api/v1/public/users/{id}. Scope write:users.

services.description: Service ids the agent belongs to.

tools.name: orkelis_deactivate_user
tools.title: Deactivate a user
tools.description: Deactivate an agent (user). The agent stays in the account but is no longer scheduled. Orkelis DELETE /api/v1/public/users/{id}. Scope write:users.

tools.name: orkelis_list_plannings
tools.title: List plannings
tools.description: List planning assignments and shifts between two dates, with optional service, agent and shift type filters. Orkelis GET /api/v1/public/plannings. Scope read:plannings.

shiftType.description: Filter by shift type, for example MORNING, AFTERNOON or NIGHT.

page.description: Page number, from 1. Ignored when cursor is set.

tools.name: orkelis_list_absences
tools.title: List absences
tools.description: List absences and leave requests, with optional date range, agent and type filters. Orkelis GET /api/v1/public/absences. Scope read:absences.

type.description: Absence type: paid leave, unpaid leave, sick leave, training day or shift swap.

page.description: Page number, from 1. Ignored when cursor is set.

tools.name: orkelis_create_absence
tools.title: Add an absence
tools.description: Create an absence or leave request for an agent. Orkelis POST /api/v1/public/absences. Scope write:absences.

type.description: Absence type: paid leave, unpaid leave, sick leave, training day or shift swap.

tools.name: orkelis_cancel_absence
tools.title: Cancel an absence
tools.description: Cancel an absence or leave request. Orkelis DELETE /api/v1/public/absences/{id}. Scope write:absences.

tools.name: orkelis_list_time_entries
tools.title: List time entries
tools.description: List clock-in and clock-out time entries between two dates, with optional agent and method filters. Orkelis GET /api/v1/public/time-entries. Scope read:time-entries.

page.description: Page number, from 1. Ignored when cursor is set.
